description: This PHP source file defines the Env class in the JmesPath namespace, providing environment-based runtime creation, cache cleaning, and environment variable retrieval for JMESPath expression evaluation.

classes.name: Env
classes.description: Provides environment-based JMESPath search functionality, runtime creation, cache management, and environment variable access.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Evaluates a JMESPath expression against data using a runtime created based on environment variables.

methods.name: createRuntime
methods.description: Creates a JMESPath runtime object based on environment variable settings.

methods.name: cleanCompileDir
methods.description: Deletes compiled JMESPath PHP files from the cache directory or temp directory.

methods.name: getEnvVariable
methods.description: Retrieves the value of an environment variable from $_SERVER, $_ENV, or getenv().
